ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated at the central fluke base and hinge, and 55% high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels across the mid and outer lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized solid black pigmentation extending from the notch to the peduncle. White pigmentation dominates both lobes with heavy dark mottling and punctate speckling concentrated along the lower trailing edge. A distinct yellowish-tan discoloration is localized on the upper-medial region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch; calculated interior angle approximately 50 degrees with high pixel depth at the central hinge point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. Multiple distinct peaks and valleys across the entire boundary. Notable jagged indentation located on the medial section of the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave upward trajectory; both lobes terminate in sharp, upward-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast white calcified protrusions (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear scratches and rake marks visible across the white surface of both lobes, particularly prominent as diagonal disruptions on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on distal tips; irregular trailing edge geometry on the right lobe suggesting minor historical tissue loss or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish/tan biological film or staining on the right lobe near the upper trailing edge.
